marketing_description: The Makita GSL02M1 Double Bevel Sliding Miter Saw is a tool designed for precision cutting. It features a 8-1/2 in crosscut capacity and 6-1/2 in vertical capacity, with a cutting angle range of 0 to 45 degrees. Powered by a 40 V Lithium-Ion battery, this saw delivers 3800 RPM and includes a large 3-1/2 in dust collection port.
